name: cut-silences
title_zh: 剪掉静音前先给你看时间轴标记，你点头才落刀
tagline_zh: 剪辑师喊「把停顿删了」时，别再盲切。它先框出每段静音起止，标好时长，等你逐段确认才动手，误伤人声的返工直接少一半。
tagline_en: When the editor says "drop the pauses," don't blind-cut. It maps each silence with start/end and duration, waits.
desc_en: Use when the editor asks to remove silences, gaps, pauses, dead air, or tighten a talking-head sequence. Plan, show, confirm, apply.
why_zh: 把「删静音」从一次性赌注变成可回退的协作：先规划后执行，每段静音都过你的眼。
why_en: Turns "cut silences" from a one-shot gamble into reviewable teamwork: plan first, then apply, with every gap shown for your call.
limit_zh: 只处理时间轴上的静音/间隙，不负责降噪、去口水声或重排节奏；且必须由剪辑师先发起请求，它不会主动扫描素材。
limit_en: Only trims silence/gaps on the timeline—no noise reduction, mouth-click removal, or pacing rework. Requires an explicit editor request; won't.
title_en: Mark silences on timeline, cut only after you confirm
